system.description: As a Swift Action, you can spend a Force Point to fly. You gain a fly speed equal to your base speed, and you can ascend at half speed or descend at double speed. The flight lasts until the start of your next turn; if you're still airborne at that time, you fall.

prerequisite.text: a member of The Witches of Dathomir
